Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 001A is engineered with the lightest and strongest materials for mindless comfort on mindful pursuits. Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe equipped with a proprietary Arnitel® TPEE midsole that demonstrates benchmark resiliency, strength and mechanical property retention, along with the world’s first seamless Dyneema® upper and an exclusive Vibram® soleplate for unparalleled performance and durability.  The 001A runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. #### Will the 001A work for wider feet?  Yes. The 001A accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with slightly wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 001A work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 001A offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 001A good as a daily trainer?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts. The 001A’s Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain, including technical terrain. #### What are the differences between the 001A and the 001?  The 001A is an upgraded and updated version of our foundational 001. It features a new Arnitel TPEE midsole that offers increased comfort, responsiveness, and energy return, all without a break-in period. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts.  It’s our most versatile, do-everything model. #### Are norda 001A shoes waterproof?  The standard 001A is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows airflow and drainage. If you need additional protection, the 001A G+ offers waterproofing rated to 10,000mm.  #### Are norda 001A shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice. #### How durable is the upper on the 001A?  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance. By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the norda shoes. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 001A’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 001A features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 001A last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity and durability. As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 001A while maintaining performance. Longevity and durability are key reasons customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### Can I use the 001A for lifestyle/casual wear?  Yes. Although the 001A is designed for trail running performance, the same qualities that make it excellent for off-road running — cushioning, support, fit, durability — translate well to the demands of daily, casual wear. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055? Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 001A is engineered with the lightest and strongest materials for mindless comfort on mindful pursuits. Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe equipped with a proprietary Arnitel® TPEE midsole that demonstrates benchmark resiliency, strength and mechanical property retention, along with the world’s first seamless Dyneema® upper and an exclusive Vibram® soleplate for unparalleled performance and durability.  The 001A runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. #### Will the 001A work for wider feet?  Yes. The 001A accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with slightly wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 001A work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 001A offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 001A good as a daily trainer?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts. Its Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across any surface. #### Is the 001A good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 001A is an upgraded and updated version of our foundational 001. It features a new Arnitel TPEE midsole that offers increased comfort, responsiveness, and energy return, all without a break-in period. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts.  It’s our most versatile, do-everything model. #### Are norda 001A shoes waterproof?  The standard 001A is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows airflow and drainage. If you need additional protection, the 001A G+ offers waterproofing rated to 10,000mm.  #### Are norda 001A shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice. #### How durable is the upper on the 001A?  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance. By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the norda shoes. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 001A’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 001A features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 001A last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity and durability. As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 001A while maintaining performance. Longevity and durability are key reasons customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### Can I use the 001A for lifestyle/casual wear?  Yes. Although the 001A is designed for trail running performance, the same qualities that make it excellent for off-road running — cushioning, support, fit, durability — translate well to the demands of daily, casual wear. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055? The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. Engineered for race day(s). The 005 features new technologies aimed to redefine what trail running super shoe performance should feel like. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel. products.description: Laceless shoe that transitions effortlessly between hiking, scrambling, and running.   Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1 full size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 003 G+ is a durable, supportive approach shoe designed to transition seamlessly between hiking, scrambling and running. This laceless approach shoe utilizing a customized Vibram® midsole and soleplate as its foundation allows for long days on feet with uncompromising traction.   A Bio-Dyneema® upper with an added elasticized Bio-Dyneema® allows for a fit that remains unchanged over time. Between a padded heel collar and reversed heel tab is a pull tab through which the shoes can easily be clipped to a pack. Excels on adventures of all conditions and duration. No wrong approach.  Drop / Stack: 5mm / Heel: 26mm, Forefoot: 21mm  The 003 runs small. Most runners size up a full size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. #### Will the 003 work for wider feet?  Yes. The 003 accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many customers with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 003 work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 003 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does the 003 have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 003 a running shoe?  While the 003 can be used as a running shoe, it’s a trail approach shoe — designed to transition seamlessly between hiking, scrambling and running. Think of it as an all-purpose outdoors shoe.  The 003 is best for adventures that require multiple forms of movement like hiking and scrambling, as well as for any wearer who leads an active lifestyle. Its durability and versatility make it an excellent choice for everything from through hikes to travel and casual wear. #### Does the 003 require a break-in period?  The 003’s upper is a unique laceless construction with an elasticized Bio-Dyneema upper. Though it may feel snug to the top of the foot at first, it molds to your feet quickly, providing an adaptable, personalized fit. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 003 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage.  If you need additional protection, the 003 G+, a 003 with a water-resistant and thermoregulating graphene membrane offers water resistance rated to 10,000mm. #### Are nordas good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model  equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 003. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 003’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 003 features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and groomed trails — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 003 last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity and durability.  Many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 003 while maintaining performance. Longevity and durability are key reasons that customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055?  The 000 is designed for efficient alpine movement and can withstand the rigors of a long day in the mountains, tackling any type of terrain or movement, from trail running to scrambling.  The 001A is the workhorse model of the norda lineup, an optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe capable of daily training efforts and racing alike. The 001A features an upgraded midsole with Arnitel TPEE foam for greater responsiveness and energy return.  The 002 is made for those who prefer a low-to-the ground, precision feel on technical terrain. By

products.description: A durable lower stack height shoe for precision through technical terrain.   Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1 full size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  Reach higher ground. Introducing the world’s most responsive trail running shoe for technical terrain made with bio-based Dyneema®. A lower stack height provides increased ground feel and heightens your connection to the earth. A padded heel collar and pyramidal midsole geometry promotes confident footing in technical environments, allowing you to reach new heights.  Drop / Stack: 4mm / Heel 19mm, Forefoot 15mm  The 002 runs small. Most runners size up a full size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide secure lockdown. #### Will it work for wider feet?  Yes. The 002 accommodates wider feet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will it work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 002 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 002 good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 002 was specifically designed to provide a low-to-the-ground feel on technical terrain. Its Dyneema upper, Vibram SLE midsole and Vibram Litebase/Megagrip outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 002’s lightweight construction and durability make it suitable for long distances. It is not categorized as a “max cushion” shoe, however, so runners who prefer more cushioning or a thicker midsole instead of a low-to-the-ground feel may want to look towards the 001A or 005. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 002 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are norda shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running.   For extreme or icy conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model  equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme durability and abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 002. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 002’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 002 features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and groomed trails alike — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 002 last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity.  As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 002 while maintaining performance. Longevity is a key reason customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055?  The 000 is designed for efficient alpine movement and can withstand the rigors of a long day in the mountains, tackling any type of terrain or movement, from trail running to scrambling.  The 001A is the workhorse model of the norda lineup, an optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe capable of daily training efforts and racing alike. The 001A features an upgraded midsole with Arnitel TPEE foam for greater responsiveness and energy return.  The 002 is made for those who prefer a low-to-the ground, precision feel on technical terrain. By lessening the distance between you and the earth, it provides confident footing in uneven environments.  The 003 is a laceless approach shoe designed to transition seamlessly between hiking, scrambling and running.  The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  Disclaimer: Spikes cannot be removed. Not to be worn indoors.   The 001 G+ Spike is optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe built to withstand icy and wet conditions. Equipped with a Vibram SLE midsole that demonstrates unparalleled resiliency and responsiveness.   Engineered with a paper-thin graphene G+® membrane that provides thermoregulating and water resistant properties without sacrificing breathability and carbide steel spikes that offer confident traction on icy terrain. Features the world’s first seamless Dyneema® upper and an exclusive Vibram® soleplate for unparalleled performance and durability.  #### How does the 001 G+ Spike fit?  The 001 G+ Spike runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one. The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown.  Graphene is the thinnest, strongest, and most conductive naturally occurring material in the world, even winning a Nobel Prize in physics. It’s water-resistant to 10,000mm, breathable, bacteriostatic, and offers excellent thermoregulatory capabilities, meaning it excels in cold and wet environments.  #### What are the spikes on the 001 G+ Spike for?  The spikes on the 001 G+ Spike are for traction in the most extreme conditions: sheets of ice, snow, wet slush and other winter conditions. Since they’re embedded directly into the sole (10 on each shoe), they remove the need to purchase external running spikes. #### What are the spikes on the 001 G+ Spike made of?  The spikes on the 001 G+ Spike are made of carbide steel, a composite material often used in industrial cutting, mining, and drilling. Carbide steel is much denser, stiffer, and more wear-resistant than standard steel. #### Will the 001 G+ Spike work for wider feet?  Yes. The 001 G+ Spike accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 001 G+ Spike work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 001 G+ Spike offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does the 001 G+ Spike have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 001 G+ Spike good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 001 G+ Spike’s Dyneema upper, Vibram midsole, Vibram outsole, and carbide steel spikes ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain, including technical terrain. #### What are the differences between the 001 G+ Spike and the 001A? products.description: Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe with an all-new Arnitel® midsole.  Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1/2 size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 001A is engineered with the lightest and strongest materials for mindless comfort on mindful pursuits. Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe equipped with a proprietary Arnitel® TPEE midsole that demonstrates benchmark resiliency, strength and mechanical property retention, along with the world’s first seamless Dyneema® upper and an exclusive Vibram® soleplate for unparalleled performance and durability.  The 001A runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. #### Will the 001A work for wider feet?  Yes. The 001A accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with slightly wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 001A work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 001A offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 001A good as a daily trainer?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts. Its Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across any surface. #### Is the 001A good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 001A’s Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain, including technical terrain. #### What are the differences between the 001A and the 001?  The 001A is an upgraded and updated version of our foundational 001. It features a new Arnitel TPEE midsole that offers increased comfort, responsiveness, and energy return, all without a break-in period. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts.  It’s our most versatile, do-everything model. #### Are norda 001A shoes waterproof?  The standard 001A is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows airflow and drainage. If you need additional protection, the 001A G+ offers waterproofing rated to 10,000mm.  #### Are norda 001A shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice. #### How durable is the upper on the 001A?  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance. By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the norda shoes. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 001A’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 001A features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 001A last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity and durability. As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 001A while maintaining performance. Longevity and durability are key reasons customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### Can I use the 001A for lifestyle/casual wear?  Yes. Although the 001A is designed for trail running performance, the same qualities that make it excellent for off-road running — cushioning, support, fit, durability — translate well to the demands of daily, casual wear. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055? It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel. products.description: Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe with an all-new Arnitel® midsole.  Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1/2 size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 001A is engineered with the lightest and strongest materials for mindless comfort on mindful pursuits. Optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe equipped with a proprietary Arnitel® TPEE midsole that demonstrates benchmark resiliency, strength and mechanical property retention, along with the world’s first seamless Dyneema® upper and an exclusive Vibram® soleplate for unparalleled performance and durability.  The 001A runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. #### Will the 001A work for wider feet?  Yes. The 001A accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with slightly wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 001A work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 001A offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 001A good as a daily trainer?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts. Its Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across any surface. #### Is the 001A good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 001A’s Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain, including technical terrain. #### What are the differences between the 001A and the 001?  The 001A is an upgraded and updated version of our foundational 001. It features a new Arnitel TPEE midsole that offers increased comfort, responsiveness, and energy return, all without a break-in period. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 001A is optimally cushioned for ultra distances while remaining responsive enough for daily training or race efforts.  It’s our most versatile, do-everything model. #### Are norda 001A shoes waterproof?  The standard 001A is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows airflow and drainage. If you need additional protection, the 001A G+ offers waterproofing rated to 10,000mm.  #### Are norda 001A shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice. #### How durable is the upper on the 001A?  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance. By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the norda shoes. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 001A’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 001A features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 001A last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity and durability. As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 001A while maintaining performance. Longevity and durability are key reasons customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### Can I use the 001A for lifestyle/casual wear?  Yes. Although the 001A is designed for trail running performance, the same qualities that make it excellent for off-road running — cushioning, support, fit, durability — translate well to the demands of daily, casual wear. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055? products.description: The lightest, fastest and most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners.  Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1/2 size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. Engineered for race day(s). The 005 features new technologies aimed to redefine what trail running super shoe performance should feel like. Rather than simply take technological conventions from road running and apply them to trail, we have developed a highly responsive and stable shoe with super critical foam that caters to the specific demands of race day performance on trail.  7.0mm approx. foot position / Heel: 28.5mm, Forefoot: 21.5mm  The 005 runs small. Most runners size up a half size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide secure lockdown. #### Will it work for wider feet?  Yes. The 005 accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will it work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 005 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 005 good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 005 was specifically designed to provide high speed over technical terrain. Its Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram Litebase/Megagrip Elite outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain.   It’s built to handle technical trails confidently. #### Was the 005 designed for racing?  Yes. The 005 is norda’s “race day(s)” shoe, meaning it was designed to handle the demands of several race days. Lightness, speed, and energy return are provided by its pure Arnitel TPEE midsole, and it’s ultra lightweight, with a men’s US size 8.5 weighing a mere 214g. #### Is the 005 norda’s lightest shoe?  Yes. It’s also one of the lightest trail racing shoes in the world. A men’s size 8.5 US weighs 214g and a women’s size 8 US wears 177g. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 005’s lightweight construction and durability make it suitable for long distances at both easy and race day efforts. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 005 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are nordas good for winter running?  Though the 005 is capable on slick and slippery terrain, its primary goal and focus is speed and lightness. If you’re frequently running on terrain like hard-packed snow, we’d recommend the 001A or 002 — or, for extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 005. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 005’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 005 features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 005 last?  The 005 is a “race day(s)” shoe. Unlike most other race day shoes, which are only optimized for a single all-out effort, the 005’s durability and construction can keep it intact for multiple races and hundreds of miles. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055?  The 000 is designed for efficient alpine movement and can withstand the rigors of a long day in the mountains, tackling any type of terrain or movement, from trail running to scrambling.  The 001A is the workhorse model of the norda lineup, an optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe capable of daily training efforts and racing alike. The 001A features an upgraded midsole with Arnitel TPEE foam for greater responsiveness and energy return.  The 002 is made for those who prefer a low-to-the ground, precision feel on technical terrain. By lessening the distance between you and the earth, it provides confident footing in uneven environments. Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. Engineered for race day(s). The 005 features new technologies aimed to redefine what trail running super shoe performance should feel like. Rather than simply take technological conventions from road running and apply them to trail, we have developed a highly responsive and stable shoe with super critical foam that caters to the specific demands of race day performance on trail.  7.0mm approx. foot position / Heel: 28.5mm, Forefoot: 21.5mm  The 005 runs small. Most runners size up a half size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide secure lockdown. #### Will it work for wider feet?  Yes. The 005 accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will it work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 005 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 005 good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 005 was specifically designed to provide high speed over technical terrain. Its Dyneema upper, Arnitel TPEE midsole and Vibram Litebase/Megagrip Elite outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain.   It’s built to handle technical trails confidently. #### Was the 005 designed for racing?  Yes. The 005 is norda’s “race day(s)” shoe, meaning it was designed to handle the demands of several race days. Lightness, speed, and energy return are provided by its pure Arnitel TPEE midsole, and it’s ultra lightweight, with a men’s US size 8.5 weighing a mere 214g. #### Is the 005 norda’s lightest shoe?  Yes. It’s also one of the lightest trail racing shoes in the world. A men’s size 8.5 US weighs 214g and a women’s size 8 US wears 177g. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 005’s lightweight construction and durability make it suitable for long distances at both easy and race day efforts. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 005 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are nordas good for winter running?  Though the 005 is capable on slick and slippery terrain, its primary goal and focus is speed and lightness. If you’re frequently running on terrain like hard-packed snow, we’d recommend the 001A or 002 — or, for extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 005. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 005’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 005 features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and hardpack — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 005 last?  The 005 is a “race day(s)” shoe. Unlike most other race day shoes, which are only optimized for a single all-out effort, the 005’s durability and construction can keep it intact for multiple races and hundreds of miles. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055?  The 000 is designed for efficient alpine movement and can withstand the rigors of a long day in the mountains, tackling any type of terrain or movement, from trail running to scrambling.  The 001A is the workhorse model of the norda lineup, an optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe capable of daily training efforts and racing alike. The 001A features an upgraded midsole with Arnitel TPEE foam for greater responsiveness and energy return.  The 002 is made for those who prefer a low-to-the ground, precision feel on technical terrain. By lessening the distance between you and the earth, it provides confident footing in uneven environments. products.description: A durable lower stack height shoe for precision through technical terrain.   Fit Guide: We recommend to go up 1 full size (US) from your regular size.  Use our size chart below to help find your size. In between sizes? Take the larger size.   Instructions on how to measure your feet below the size chart.  Follow these easy steps to find the perfect size for you. For the best fit, we recommend measuring your feet wearing the socks you run in.  Stand on a piece of paper lengthwise. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  Reach higher ground. Introducing the world’s most responsive trail running shoe for technical terrain made with bio-based Dyneema®. A lower stack height provides increased ground feel and heightens your connection to the earth. A padded heel collar and pyramidal midsole geometry promotes confident footing in technical environments, allowing you to reach new heights.  Drop / Stack: 4mm / Heel 19mm, Forefoot 15mm  The 002 runs small. Most runners size up a full size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide secure lockdown. #### Will it work for wider feet?  Yes. The 002 accommodates wider feet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will it work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 002 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 002 good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 002 was specifically designed to provide a low-to-the-ground feel on technical terrain. Its Dyneema upper, Vibram SLE midsole and Vibram Litebase/Megagrip outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 002’s lightweight construction and durability make it suitable for long distances. It is not categorized as a “max cushion” shoe, however, so runners who prefer more cushioning or a thicker midsole instead of a low-to-the-ground feel may want to look towards the 001A or 005. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 002 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are norda shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running.   For extreme or icy conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model  equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme durability and abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 002. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 002’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different?  The 002 features a custom Vibram® outsole developed exclusively with norda.  Vibram®, founded in 1937 in Italy, is widely regarded as the leader in high-performance rubber compounds. Our proprietary Vibram® formulation balances grip, durability, and traction across wet rock, loose terrain, and groomed trails alike — ensuring consistent performance in varied trail conditions. #### How long will the 002 last?  It depends on how hard you are on your shoes and the conditions you play in. norda footwear is put through rigorous lab testing and trail running before final production, and built with the finest materials available to ensure its longevity.  As a general guideline, running shoes should be replaced around 700 km (500 miles).  However, many norda athletes exceed 1,600 km (1,000 miles) in their 002 while maintaining performance. Longevity is a key reason customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. Simply replace the stock insole with your custom orthotic. #### What is the difference between the 000, 001A, 002, 003, 005, 008, and 055?  The 000 is designed for efficient alpine movement and can withstand the rigors of a long day in the mountains, tackling any type of terrain or movement, from trail running to scrambling.  The 001A is the workhorse model of the norda lineup, an optimally-cushioned ultra distance shoe capable of daily training efforts and racing alike. The 001A features an upgraded midsole with Arnitel TPEE foam for greater responsiveness and energy return.  The 002 is made for those who prefer a low-to-the ground, precision feel on technical terrain. By lessening the distance between you and the earth, it provides confident footing in uneven environments.  The 003 is a laceless approach shoe designed to transition seamlessly between hiking, scrambling and running.  The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 001A’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different? Longevity and durability are key reasons customers cite norda’s lower cost per wear compared to traditional trail shoes. #### Can I use my own orthotic insole?  Yes. All norda insoles are removable. products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Couldn't load pickup availability  K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Couldn't load pickup availability  K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Yes. The 005 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox? Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 005 good for technical terrain? Yes. The 005 was specifically designed to provide high speed over technical terrain. It’s built to handle technical trails confidently. #### Was the 005 designed for racing? Yes. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are nordas good for winter running? Though the 005 is capable on slick and slippery terrain, its primary goal and focus is speed and lightness. If you’re frequently running on terrain like hard-packed snow, we’d recommend the 001A or 002 — or, for extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Regular price~~ $75.00 ~~Sale price $52.50   6.5   7   7.5   8   8.5   9   9.5   10   10.5   11   11.5   12   13   14   15   16   Couldn't load pickup availability K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Regular price~~ $75.00 ~~Sale price $75.00   6.5   7   7.5   8   8.5   9   9.5   10   10.5   11   11.5   12   13   14   15   16   Couldn't load pickup availability K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Couldn't load pickup availability  K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

products.name: CLASSIC VN
products.description: Couldn't load pickup availability  K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage.

The Dragguard 7.0 rubber outsole is designed with a herringbone tread pattern for excellent balance between grip and slide on all court surfaces.

While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  Reach higher ground. Introducing the world’s most responsive trail running shoe for technical terrain made with bio-based Dyneema®. A lower stack height provides increased ground feel and heightens your connection to the earth. A padded heel collar and pyramidal midsole geometry promotes confident footing in technical environments, allowing you to reach new heights.  Drop / Stack: 4mm / Heel 19mm, Forefoot 15mm  The 002 runs small. Most runners size up a full size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toe box is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide secure lockdown. #### Will it work for wider feet?  Yes. The 002 accommodates wider feet thanks to its anatomical toe box. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will it work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 002 offers secure lockdown through the midfoot and heel, ensuring that wearers with narrow feet will be both secure and comfortable. #### Does it have a wide toebox?  Yes. All norda footwear has an anatomical toebox to allow for natural foot splay. #### Is the 002 good for technical terrain?  Yes. The 002 was specifically designed to provide a low-to-the-ground feel on technical terrain. Its Dyneema upper, Vibram SLE midsole and Vibram Litebase/Megagrip outsole ensure that it’s durable, protective, supportive and grippy across all types of terrain. #### Is it suitable for long distances?  Yes. The 002’s lightweight construction and durability make it suitable for long distances. It is not categorized as a “max cushion” shoe, however, so runners who prefer more cushioning or a thicker midsole instead of a low-to-the-ground feel may want to look towards the 001A or 005. #### Are norda shoes waterproof?  The standard 002 is water-resistant. Dyneema® is hydrophobic and does not absorb water, but the woven construction allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are norda shoes good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running.   For extreme or icy conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model  equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-based Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme durability and abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 002. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. While in a standing position, mark horizontal lines where the tip of your longest toe lands as well as where the end of your heel is.  Measure the heel-to-toe distance to find your foot length.  The 055 G+® is built to withstand wet and cold conditions and features trail running's most propulsive midsole, an integrated knit collar, durable and breathable bio-circular Dyneema® upper, and norda x Vibram soleplate with Megagrip Elite® and Litebase®, technologies for unparalleled performance and durability.   6mm / Heel: 36mm, Forefoot: 30mm (31mm/25mm midsole + 3mm insole)  The 055 G+ runs slightly small. Most runners size up ½ size. If you’re between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.  The toebox is naturally shaped to allow for toe splay, while the midfoot and heel provide a secure, performance lockdown. Yes. The 055 G+ accommodates wider forefeet thanks to its anatomical toebox. While not classified as a “wide” shoe, many runners with wider feet find it comfortable. #### Will the 055 G+ work for narrower feet?  Yes. The 055 G+ and other norda models with a graphene membrane (001 G+ Spike, 001A G+ and 003 G+) offer water resistance rated to 10,000 mm.   Non-G+ models are naturally water-resistant as well, as Dyneema is hydrophobic and does not absorb water. However, their woven construction intentionally allows for airflow and drainage. #### Are nordas good for winter running?  Yes. The traction, durability and cushioning of norda shoes makes them an excellent option for winter running. For extreme conditions, the 001 G+ Spike is ideal. It’s a winterized version of our foundational 001 model  equipped with durable carbide steel spikes that provide traction on snow and even ice.  The bio-circular Dyneema® upper is engineered for extreme abrasion resistance.  By weight, Dyneema® is up to 15x stronger than steel and significantly more durable than traditional mesh or knit uppers. Durability is one of the defining features of the 055 G+. #### What is Dyneema® and why does it matter?  Dyneema® is the world’s strongest and lightest fiber. It’s up to 15x stronger than steel by weight, meaning that a pound of Dyneema is 15 times stronger than a pound of steel.  Dyneema® delivers exceptional abrasion resistance, cut resistance, and long-term durability, without adding weight. Compared to traditional mesh or knit uppers, it maintains structure and performance far longer, which directly contributes to the 055’s longevity and cost-per-wear advantage. #### What’s the difference between the 005 and 055?  Each shoe is a tool for a different purpose. The 005 is our  lightest, fastest trail race day shoe. The 055 (and 055 G+) takes the technological learnings from the 005 — Arnitel® TPEE midsoles, Vibram® Megagrip Elite® soleplate rubber — and applies them in a different context, specifically on a shoe designed for ultra-long distance running, training, racing, and rugged terrain. That means that the 055 weighs more than the 005, but also features more cushioning and enhanced lockdown.  #### Is the 055 G+ a race shoe?  Yes. The 055 G+ was designed for ultra-distance efforts across all terrains and conditions. Speed and energy return are provided by its pure Arnitel TPEE midsole, while a knit collar and bio-circular Dyneema® upper supply lockdown. A bespoke Vibram® Megagrip Elite® soleplate ensures grip in all conditions. #### Is the 055 G+ suitable for shorter runs?  Yes. The 055 G+ can be used for everything from short-distance training runs to multi-day racing efforts. #### What makes the Vibram® outsole different? products.description: # [11/27 예약발송] 여성 에어플로우 후드 경량 다운 # [11/27 예약발송] 여성 에어플로우 후드 경량 다운  Translation missing: ko.products.product.all  * 예약판매 상품은 11/27(금)부터 순차적으로 출고되며,  배송사 사정에 따라 배송은 1~2일 지연될 수 있습니다. 곡선형 절개 디테일을 적용해 부드럽고 트렌디한 무드의 경량 후드 다운 입니다. 충전재가 은은하게 비치는 시어한 소재를 사용해 포인트가 되며 투명감 있는 텍스처로 유니크하고 감각적인 무드를 연출합니다. 밑단 스트링과 2-WAY지퍼를 사용하여 더욱 편안한 핏을 연출 할 수 있습니다. 프리미엄 유러피안 덕다운 충전재를 사용하여 착용시 가볍고 보온성 극대화 하였습니다.  겉감 : 나일론 100%, 안감 : 나일론 100%, 충전백 : 폴리에스터 100%, 충전재 : 오리 솜털 80%, 오리 깃털 20% ## [11/27 예약발송] 여성 에어플로우 후드 경량 다운  · 결제 후 대략 영업일 3~5일 이내 배송이 완료됩니다.  · 상품의 배송 진행 상황은 [마이페이지] > [주문배송조회] 에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.  · 특정 상품의 경우 재고 상황에 따라 도착일이 지연될 수 있습니다.  · 매장 발송이 섞여있는 주문 건의 경우 물류센터와 매장에서 상품이 각각 발송될 수 있습니다.  전국배송가능 (해외배송 서비스는 현재 제공되지 않습니다.)  휠라 온라인스토어는 3만원 이상 구매 시 무료 배송 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.  상품 결제를 완료하였더라도 출고시점 재고 부족으로 품절 시 출고 불가하여 품절 안내 후 주문취소처리 될 수 있음을 양해부탁드립니다.  [로그인] → [마이페이지] → [주문/배송조회] → [주문 상세] → [반품신청] → [반품 상품 선택] → [반품 사유 등록] → [환불금액 확인] → [신청완료] → [선택상품 주문 반품]  [로그인 창 하단 비회원 주문 조회] → [주문 선택] → [주문 상세] → [반품신청] → [반품 상품 선택] → [반품 사유 등록] → [환불금액 확인] → [신청완료] → [선택상품 주문 반품]  반품을 원하시는 상품이 물류센터로 입고 후 검수과정을 거친 뒤 환불이 진행됩니다.  환불 승인후 영업일 기준 3~5일 이내 결제 수단으로 환불처리 됩니다.  [로그인] → [마이페이지] → [주문/배송조회] → [주문 상세] → [교환신청] → [교환 가능 상품 선택] → [교환 사유 등록] → [방문 수거지 확인] → [신청완료] → [선택상품 주문 반품]  [로그인 창 하단 비회원 주문 조회] → [주문 선택] → [주문 상세] → [교환신청] → [교환 가능 상품 선택] → [교환 사유 등록] → [방문 수거지 확인] → [신청완료] → [선택상품 주문 반품]  · [상품수거-물류로 상품입고-상품검수-교환상품 재출고]의 과정에서 영업일 기준 4일정도 소요될 수 있으며, 교환 진행 도중 상품이 품절될 경우 교환 상품의 출고가 어려워 환불안내 받으실 수도 있습니다.  · 3만원 이상 구매시: 교환 6,000원, 반품 6,000원이 발생됩니다.  · 3만원 미만 구매시: 교환 6,000원, 반품 3,000원이 발생됩니다.  · (단, 고객님의 부주의로 상품이 훼손될 경우에는 교환/반품이 불가하여 안내 후 반송될 수 있습니다)  구매하신 제품의 반품 신청 접수 후 CJ 대한통운에서 3일 내 (영업일 기준) 방문 수거가 진행됩니다.  반품 접수가 없이 임의로 발송하시는 경우, 정확한 반품처리가 어려울 수 있습니다.  수거 시 확인되는 반송장 번호는 환불이 모두 진행될 때까지 보관해주시기 바랍니다.  한 번에 여러 개의 상품을 주문하여 따로 배송받으셨더라도, 반품시 한 개의 택배 박스 안에 상품을 포장하여 주시기 바랍니다.  · 제품수령 후 7일 이내에 착용하지 않은 상품일 경우 교환 / 반품이 가능합니다.  · 맞교환은 불가능하며, 상품이 물류센터에 도착하면 요청하신 교환 상품이 배송됩니다.  · 다른 상품으로 교환을 원하실 경우, 1:1문의를 통해 접수바랍니다.  · 지정된 택배사 이외 임의의 택배사 착불로 제품을 보내실 경우 반송될 수 있는 점 양해 바랍니다.  · 상품이 품절될 경우 교환 상품의 출고가 어려워 환불안내 받으실 수도 있습니다.  · 출고 전 : 주문서 수정은 불가하기에 사이즈, 색상 변경 원하실 경우 취소후 재구매 해주셔야합니다.  · 출고 후 : 이미 출고가 완료된 경우에는 주문취소가 불가하기에 수령 후 반품 접수 진행주셔야합니다.  쿠폰적용하여 구매 후 부분취소, 환불 시 쿠폰조건에 부합하지 않은 경우 환불이 불가하거나 쿠폰 적용이 되지 않아 쿠폰 사용 금액을 제외하고 환불될수 있습니다.  · 고객님의 단순변심으로 인한 교환/반품 요청이 상품을 수령한 날로부터 7일을 경과한 경우  · 고객님의 책임 있는 사유로 상품 등의 가치가 파손되거나 훼손된 경우  · 상품의 구성품을 분실하였거나 취급 부주의로 인한 훼손, 고장, 오염된 경우 (단추,상품의 부속품, 택,라벨,신발 박스, 사은품 등)  · 모니터 해상도의 차이로 인해 색상이나 이미지가 실제와 다를수 있으며, 이로 인한 반품 및 교환이 제한될 수 있습니다.  · 기타, '전자상거래 등에서의 소비자 보호에 관한 법률'에 의한 청약철회 제한사유에 해당되는 경우  사용 전 주의사항은 제품에 붙은 안내 택을 반드시 참고하여 주시기 바랍니다.  · 본 제품은 원단 특성상 반드시 단독 세탁하시기 바랍니다.  · 본 제품은 수분에 의해 이염될 수 있으니 젖은 의류를 담는 것을 삼가시고 건조한 상태로 유지하여 주십시오.  · 본 제품은 나일론 스판 원단 특성상 보관 중 황변 현상이 발생하기 쉬운 소재이므로 열, 빛, 화학약품, 밀폐된  공간에서의 장시간 보관을 피해주시고 건조한 상태로 환기가 잘 되는 곳에 보관 바랍니다. 특히, 직사광선이나 매장  · 세탁 시 드라이클리닝, 온수, 열풍건조세탁기 사용은 삼가 주십시오.  · 본 제품은 기계 건조(열풍건조)에 의해 손상될 수 있으니 삼가 주십시오.  · 본 제품은 원단 특성상 올뜯김이 발생될 수 있으므로 반드시 단독 세탁하시기 바랍니다.  · 본 제품은 제품 특성상 세탁 후 물 빠짐 현상이 발생할 수 있으므로 세탁 후 반드시 뒤집어서 건조하여 주십시오.  · FILA 제품의 품질보증기간은 구입일로부터 1년 입니다.  · 제품의 불량에 의한 반품, 교환, A/S 등은 공정거래위원회에서 고시한 소비자분쟁해결기준에 따라 반품, 교환, A/S를 받을 수 있습니다.  오전 9시 - 오후 6시 (점심시간 : 오전 12시 ~ 오후 1시)  토, 일, 법정공휴일, 휴무일은 휴무로 고객센터 운영이 되지 않습니다.  프리미엄 유러피안 덕다운 충전재를 사용해 무게 부담은 줄이면서도 뛰어난 보온성을 제공합니다. 간절기부터 추운 날씨까지 따뜻하고 편안하게 착용할 수 있습니다.  부드럽게 이어지는 곡선형 절개 디테일을 적용해 경량 다운의 볼륨감을 자연스럽게 정돈하고, 세련되면서도 트렌디한 실루엣을 연출합니다.  충전재가 은은하게 비치는 시어 소재를 사용해 경량 다운 특유의 가벼운 분위기를 살렸습니다. 투명감이 느껴지는 유니크한 텍스처가 단독 착용만으로도 감각적인 스타일을 완성합니다.  밑단 스트링을 조절해 여유 있는 기본 실루엣부터 볼륨감 있는 블루종 스타일까지 다양하게 연출할 수 있어 코디와 착용 상황에 따라 핏을 자유롭게 조절할 수 있습니다.  *모델 착용 이미지보다 제품컷 이미지의 컬러가 정확합니다.
